vector_set: Canonical NDC v2 Profile 1 — required source scope identifiers
note: Abstract identifier strings only. No venue, product, provider or dataset identity here refers to an external source.

cases.rule: All five identifiers are required non-empty valid identifiers in Profile 1.
A null venue fails the required non-empty identifier rule; venue-less sources are outside Profile 1.
An empty venue fails strict validation.
A null segment fails the required non-empty identifier rule; no history or other placeholder default exists.
Placeholder literals UNKNOWN, ALL, NONE and null are rejected in every required scope identifier.
Placeholders are rejected in provider, product, venue, segment and dataset identifiers alike.
Missing required members are rejected; there is no default dataset.
